_comment: Reviewed, line-preserving OCR corrections to the Raman book corpus (2026-10-23). Scope: every line the engine cites (code Citation objects, WORK:line tokens, golden citations) plus a whole-book pass over Notable Horoscopes. Each change is a whole-word fix from a hand-reviewed map: unambiguous OCR garbles only (h/b, F/L, E/F confusions, broken planet names, run-together words). Valid Sanskrit terms are never touched, digits never change, and no line is added or removed, so every citation keeps its line number. Apply with tools/raman_saab/apply_ocr_corrections.py, then re-lock the sources. Second pass (2026-10-24): Notable Horoscopes re-OCR'd with tesseract from the owner's epub page scans and aligned word by word with this text; every chart's birth data and planetary positions were compared and each differing block was read on the page image. Those entries carry 'verified' and are the only ones allowed to change a digit. Charts whose page has no scan in the epub (Nos. 9, 17, 48, 49 and the 1906 nativity) were left untouched.
